event.title: Delia's Birthday
event.description: On October 26th, 2004, Delia Autumn Abramoski was born at Magee-Womens, UPMC Hamot.

event.title: Keeping Busy
event.description: From ages 6-17, Delia is enrolled in gymnastics, tumbling, sideline and competition cheer. Lots of exercise, and lots of gold medals!

event.title: First College Course
event.description: During the summer before her senior year of highschool, Delia decided to enroll in something called the LEADS program at Penn State Behrend. She was able to get 3 college credits that summer, and continued to do dual enrollment throughout her senior year of Highschool.

event.title: Present Day
event.description: Delia just entered her senior year of college at Penn State Behrend. Although she switched her major a few times (ultimately making this her first senior year of 2), she's just happy that she found what she's passionate about.

event.title: Anticipated Graduation Date
event.description: Delia is anticipated to graduate from Penn State Behrend in Spring of 2028, majoring in Digital Media, Arts, and Technology, and minoring in Data Visualization.
